svg.aria-label: Height against time for each take-off at 0.1, 0.2 and 0.4 m/s
svg.text: First flight 3: height in every take-off, by climb speed
Down range (Flow deck) from the take-off send. Dashed verticals: each speed's climb time limit. Gray: 0.2 m/s take-offs in good light (floor image quality 53-96), for comparison.
